name: Poltergeist
description:
You attack by controlling the target's item. The target must make a {save} or lose a hold of their item. On a failed save, you may immediately make one melee attack against one creature within 5 feet of the item. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage.

As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of the item.

The item follows within 5 feet of its owner, hovering nearby. The creature cannot benefit from the item while you control it. The items's owner may use an action on its turn to try and regain control of the item by repeating the {save}, ending the move's concentration on a successful save.
